record.name: Klang.ai: AI Meeting Notes
record.offering: Productivity app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Record any conversation, anywhere. Klang turns it into a transcript, a summary, and a list of decisions and action items you can use straight away.

Meetings, phone calls, interviews and voice notes. Klang records them wherever you are, transcribes them in minutes, and syncs everything to your workspace so your team can pick up where the conversation left off.

■ Record anywhere
One tap captures the meeting in the room or a thought on the move. No laptop needed. Recordings made offline upload by themselves once you are back online.

■ Transcripts you can trust
Multilingual transcription with automatic speaker identification, built on our own speech models rather than third-party APIs. Swedish, Norwegian and Danish are unusually strong.

■ Summaries the moment you stop
Key points, decisions and action items are ready as soon as the recording ends. The minutes write themselves.

■ Phone calls, transcribed
Record incoming and outgoing calls through Klang's call-in service. The call is ready to read, search and share by the time you hang up.

■ Find anything anyone said
"Who said that, and when?" Search every conversation in your workspace and get the quote back with the speaker and the timestamp.

■ One place for every conversation
Recordings land in your Klang workspace, where you and your team can search, organize, share and build on them from any browser.

■ Built for professionals
Research interviews, client visits, site meetings, casework documentation, and the everyday meetings in between.

■ Security first, built in Europe
Your conversations are never used to train AI.
Workspace-level encryption.
ISO 27001:2022 certified.
GDPR compliant, data stored in Europe.

■ Start free
Klang has a free plan and no card is required. Pro plans are available in the app and at klang.ai.

Founded in Sweden. Human-centered, privacy-first, built for the long term.

MeetGeek is the AI-powered note-taking app that allows you to transcribe speech to text and record audio in over 50 languages.

Use MeetGeek, the AI Note Taker, to record & transcribe:
+ face-to-face conversations 
+ online meetings 
+ training courses 
+ webinars 
+ interviews & more

From today onward, your meetings can end with an accurate transcript and an AI-generated summary in your inbox that includes key highlights, decisions, and action items discussed.


RECORD FACE-TO-FACE CONVERSATIONS
MeetGeek is a speech-to-text app that allows you to record conversations with just one touch of a button and get voice transcription and a summary of the chat shortly afterward inside the app and via email. This is especially useful if you need to keep records of your business meetings, talks from conferences, or offline meetings with clients.


TRANSCRIBE YOUR MEETINGS & CONVERSATIONS 
+ Record audio and transcribe meetings and offline conversations with just one click.
+ Automatically take meeting notes so you can focus on the conversation.
+ Have speakers labeled with tags for easy navigation.
+ Simply invite MeetGeek to meetings on your calendar and you are ready to go


WORKS WITH MAJOR VIDEO CALLING APPS
MeetGeek's web app helps you get accurate transcriptions and AI-generated summaries of your video calls held on:

+ Zoom, 
+ Google Meet 
+ Microsoft Teams


GET A SMART AI SUMMARY OF YOUR MEETINGS
+ Get a 5-min summary out of a 1-hour meeting.

+ MeetGeek detects action items, important moments, and facts from your conversation and automatically tags them.

+ Use AI Highlights to quickly review the transcripts of your past conversations.

+ Send an AI summary over email to other participants of the offline conversation or video call.


HIGHLIGHT & SHARE TRANSCRIPTS
+ Scroll back through the transcript to recall important details.
+ Share voice, video, and text notes with others.
+ Search past conversations for keywords.
+ Export transcripts of your conversations as docs.
+ Integrate with apps like Notion, Slack, ClickUp, Pipedrive, HubSpot, and others.

Write. Record. Draw. Remember.

You think faster than you can type. Draft Out closes the gap.

Your best ideas show up out loud — in a meeting, in the car, mid-walk — and then they're gone. The action item nobody wrote down. The insight that never became a decision. The idea that never became a post. 
Draft Out is the tool that finally writes it all up for you.

Just talk. Draft Out turns raw, messy, thinking-out-loud speech into clean, finished output you can actually use — and remembers all of it as a second brain that knows your context.


ONE RECORDING. EVERY FORMAT. 
Record once, get back whatever you need: 
• Clean transcript — fillers, ums, and bad grammar removed 
• Sharp summary 
• Action items and to-dos 
• A tweet, a thread, a blog post, an email 
• Or your own custom prompt — "turn this into meeting minutes," "draft a reply"

IT CATCHES WHAT YOU MISSED. 
Draft Out surfaces the action items and insights you didn't even notice you said — the follow-up a human would have forgotten, the angle worth writing down.

MEETINGS — WITHOUT A BOT. 
Walk away with the summary and action items, ready before you're back at your desk. Draft Out records from your device. Nothing joins your call as a participant. No awkward bot.

A SECOND BRAIN THAT ACTUALLY KNOWS YOU. 
Every note, meeting, and journal you record becomes a searchable, conversational memory. Ask it anything — "What were all my product ideas last month?" — and get an answer pulled from everything you've ever said. Unlike a blank-slate chatbot, it knows your actual context.

100+ LANGUAGES, DONE RIGHT. 
Think and speak in your own language. Draft Out transcribes and drafts in 100+ languages — including regional languages other voice apps mangle.

EVERYWHERE YOU THINK. 
iPhone, Mac and other devices — always in sync. 
Capture the thought wherever it happens.

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT. 
Your notes are yours. Never used to train AI. Encrypted. You own your data.

Record your first note free. Watch it write itself up.
